ItemID: 1; Title: CHANZON 100 pcs 5mm RGB Multicolor Fast Blinking (Multi Color Changing) Dynamics LED Diode Lights (Flashing Round DC) Bright Lighting Bulb Lamps Electronics Components Flicker Light Emitting Diodes; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My past electronics projects suggest practical components; I have no current use for fast color-changing lights.
ItemID: 2; Title: ELEGOO 32 Pcs Double Sided PCB Board Prototype Kit for DIY Soldering with 5 Sizes Compatible with Arduino Kits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these to turn breadboard circuits into soldered projects; the different sizes look useful.
ItemID: 3; Title: Electrical Multimeter Test Leads Set with Alligator Clips Test Hook Test Probes Lead Professional Kit 1000V 10A CAT.II; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for connecting to small components and troubleshooting the boards and relay modules I use.
ItemID: 4; Title: Transistor Tester, DROK Mosfet Transistor Capacitor Tester, Mega328 NPN PNP Transistor Diode Resistor Inductor Capacitance MOS SCR ESR Meter Automatic Checker Detector; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to identify and check components before assembling circuits, though its accuracy would matter.
ItemID: 5; Title: Multifunction Meter DIY kit, kuman Mega 328 Graphic transistor Tester, NPN PNP Diodes Triode Capacitor ESR SCR MOSFET Resistor Inductance LCD Display Checker with case and screwdriver K77; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The assembly kit fits my electronics interests, but I would choose the other component tester this time.
ItemID: 6; Title: WGGE WG-026 10 Pieces and 5 Colors Test Lead Set & Alligator Clips,20.5 inches / 22 AWG Wire (2 Pack); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These would help with temporary circuit connections, but the broader test-lead kit already covers my immediate interest.
ItemID: 7; Title: Chanzon 100 pcs 3mm Green LED Diode Lights (Clear Round Transparent DC 3V 20mA) Bright Lighting Bulb Lamps Electronics Components Indicator Light Emitting Diodes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Green indicators fit my circuit projects, but my earlier PCB kit included LEDs and I would wait until I need more.
ItemID: 8; Title: uxcell Solid State Relay with Heat Sink, SSR-25DA 25A 3-32VDC to 24-380VAC, DC-AC Relay; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My previous relay purchase does not establish a current need to switch a high-voltage AC load.
ItemID: 9; Title: AUTOTOOLHOME 1/8" 3/16" 1/4" 5/16" 3/8" 1/2" high Speed Steel HSS 4 Flute Straight End Mill Cutter 5/32" 1/16" Set of 8; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no indicated milling project or compatible machine, so these would not be useful right now.
ItemID: 10; Title: Proster Digital Thermocouple Temperature Thermometer with Two K-Type Thermocouple Probe Backlight LCD K Type Thermometer Dual Channel for K/J/T/E/R/S/N Type; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Temperature measurement interests me, but I would keep using my infrared thermometer until I need contact probes or two-point comparisons.
